items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 11:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Often cloudy today with scattered showers. Fresh to strong south or southwest winds. Maximum temperature of 11°C.

Comments: Strong winds.

A band of rain will arrive overnight, remaining persistent and heavy at times through the morning. This will gradually ease during the afternoon, though a few showers will linger. Fresh to strong, mainly southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering northwest. They will then increase to become strong, bringing a risk of gales later in the day. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

Some clear intervals and a few wintry showers overnight. Minimum temperature of 0°C on higher ground and in the central valley. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens early in the night with a band of rain soon arriving. Moderate to fresh northwest winds becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Sunrise##

7:45am Tomorrow


##Sunset##

4:19pm Tomorrow
